About A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Local Breakdown & Recovery Support in Birmingham

A.A.D Transport & Recovery is a Birmingham-based vehicle recovery company. We help drivers dealing with a breakdown, vehicle fault, or transportation need quickly, clearly, and without the runaround. Vehicle problems don't send a warning. Whether you're heading to work, driving home, passing through Birmingham, or stuck with a car that just won't start, we're the call you make to sort it out.

Our services centre on three things: roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment. From your first call to the job being done, we keep things simple and straightforward  for both urgent breakdowns and planned vehicle moves.

We're based in Birmingham, cover the city and surrounding areas, and we're available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

What We Do

Roadside Recovery

When your vehicle breaks down or becomes unsafe to drive, getting it somewhere safe is priority one. We help drivers stranded by a breakdown, fault, accident, or anything else that stops a journey in its tracks whether that means help at the roadside or transport to a garage, home, or another destination.

Learn More

Vehicle Transportation

Not every job is an emergency. Sometimes a car just needs moving because it's non-running, needs repairs, or has to get from one place to another. We handle that safely and conveniently, on your schedule.

Learn More

Vehicle Assessment

Not sure what's actually wrong with your vehicle? Our assessment service helps identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, or accident so you know exactly what's going on and what needs to happen next. If the vehicle isn't fit to drive, we'll sort recovery or transportation from there.

Learn More

Why A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

Available 24/7

Breakdowns don't check the clock. Early morning, late night, weekends, bank holidays we're on call.

Birmingham-Based Service

We're based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, and we know the city. That local knowledge means faster, more practical support for drivers across the area.

Clear Communication

We tell you what's happening with your vehicle and what comes next — no jargon, no guesswork.

Careful Vehicle Handling

Your vehicle matters. Whether it's being recovered or transported, it's handled properly, every time.

Practical Solutions

No two breakdowns are the same. We look at your actual situation and figure out the right next step — not a one-size-fits-all answer.

Our Approach to Vehicle Recovery

Simple: understand the problem, communicate clearly, and provide the right service.

When you call, we'll ask for your location, vehicle details, and what's happened. That's enough for us to work out the best way forward — whether that's checking if your non-running vehicle can roll and is accessible, or agreeing a collection point and destination for a garage transport job.

Accurate details up front mean a faster, more organised recovery.

Get A Quote

Supporting Drivers When Things Go Wrong

A breakdown is stressful enough without confusion about what to do next — especially somewhere unfamiliar, with passengers in the car, or when you're already running late.

Our job is to make the recovery side simple. Broken down on a Birmingham Road? Got a non-running vehicle stuck at home? Need something transported to a garage? Call us and we'll sort it  for both urgent and planned recovery needs.

Call Now: 07771 004242

Our Birmingham Service Area

Based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, we cover the city and surrounding areas, including:

  • Birmingham City Centre
  • Aston
  • Handsworth
  • Perry Barr
  • Erdington
  • Harborne
  • Edgbaston
  • Selly Oak
  • Moseley
  • Kings Heath
  • Yardley
  • Sheldon
  • Sutton Coldfield
  • And surrounding Birmingham areas

Not sure if we cover your postcode? Just call — we'll confirm straight away.

Our Services at a Glance

Emergency Breakdown Recovery

24/7 recovery support when your vehicle breaks down and cannot safely continue its journey.

Long-Distance Recovery

Vehicle recovery and transportation for longer journeys between Birmingham and other towns, cities or destinations.

Flatbed Recovery

Flatbed transportation for suitable non-running, damaged or specialist vehicles that require secure vehicle recovery.

Wheel-Lift Recovery

Wheel-lift recovery for suitable vehicles where part of the vehicle can be lifted for towing or transportation.

Motorcycle Recovery

Safe recovery and transportation for motorcycles following a breakdown, damage or when the motorcycle needs to be moved to another location.

Heavy-Duty Recovery

Recovery support for suitable larger vehicles that require specialist equipment and handling.

RV & Trailer Recovery

Recovery and transportation for suitable RVs and trailers, depending on their size, weight and recovery requirements.

Commercial Vehicle Towing

Towing and recovery support for suitable commercial vehicles that have broken down or need to be transported.

Accident Recovery

Recovery for vehicles that have been damaged in an accident and cannot safely continue their journey.

Breakdown Recovery

Help when your vehicle has broken down and cannot safely continue its journey.

When You May Need A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won't start
  • Has broken down
  • Has a mechanical or electrical fault
  • Can't safely continue driving
  • Needs moving to a garage or another location
  • Has been involved in an incident
  • Is a non-running vehicle
  • Needs a vehicle assessment

Not sure which service fits your situation? Call us and explain what's happened  we'll talk you through the options.

Our Commitment to Customers

We know people call a recovery company when something's already gone wrong. That could be a car that won't start, a fault needing sorted, or a non-running vehicle that needs moving safely.

Our focus stays the same throughout: practical support, clear communication, and careful handling  from the first call to the job being done.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

A Birmingham-based vehicle recovery company offering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment, operating from Walsall Road, Birmingham, 24/7.

What services does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide?

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment covering breakdowns, non-running vehicles, vehicle faults, and transport needs.

Is A.A.D Transport & Recovery available 24/7?

Yes, day or night, weekends and bank holidays included.

Where is A.A.D Transport & Recovery based?

Walsall Road, Birmingham, West Midlands, covering the city and surrounding areas.

Can you transport my vehicle to a garage?

Yes, call us to arrange collection and delivery to your garage, repair centre, home, or another destination.

Can you help if my vehicle will not start?

Yes, tell us your location and vehicle condition, and we’ll arrange the right recovery or transport option.

Do you provide vehicle assessments?

Yes, we help identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, accident, or other issue.

Do you provide both emergency and planned vehicle recovery?

Yes, urgent breakdown recovery and planned vehicle transportation, both covered.

What information should I provide when contacting you?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, and a brief description of the problem. If it’s not running, let us know whether it can roll or be moved.

Which areas do you cover?

Birmingham and surrounding areas. Unsure about your postcode? Call and we’ll confirm.

Contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Need help with a breakdown, vehicle transportation, or vehicle assessment? We're available 24/7 across Birmingham and surrounding areas.
